rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Turns isolated MCP servers into a unified, managed tool farm. Deploys any FastMCP server as a Docker container with automatic tool discovery, Redis-backed registry, and a single FastAPI gateway that multiplexes all servers. Provides API key authentication, rate limiting, Prometheus metrics, health monitoring with auto-restart, and a Next.js frontend dashboard for real-time tool invocation tracking. Includes a Python SDK with LangChain/LangGraph support for agent framework integration.
